label: Teltonika TSW100
description: A five-port industrial Gigabit switch with PoE+ on four of them: the fifth port is the uplink, the other four power cameras and access points.
notes: Vendor figures (Teltonika wiki): 5 x Gigabit Ethernet ports, 4 of which can power connected devices via PoE 802.3af/802.3at. eth0 is modelled without PoE because the vendor says four of the five ports are PoE-capable; the fifth is the uplink.
